summary: CASI Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K announcing the termination without cause of Dr. Alexander A. Zukiwski as Global Chief Medical Officer, effective April 20, 2026. No severance or compensation terms were disclosed. The company stated it will search for a long-term replacement, with Dr. Junping Chen (China CMO) assuming most responsibilities in the interim. This is an abrupt, non-routine C-suite departure. There is no shareholder vote or tender involved. The event confirms ongoing US operations streamlining. Market watchers should monitor if further management exits or restructuring follow as the company narrows its US footprint.
